category_name: Explicit correction across sessions

research_basis.note: Knowledge updates are one of LongMemEval's five core memory abilities; commercial assistants drop ~30% accuracy on sustained memory.

turns: I live in Delhi with my parents in Karol Bagh
Actually I moved to Bangalore last week for my internship

recall_probes.ask: Which city do I live in right now?

notes: Old fact must be preserved as history, not deleted.

category_name: Implicit update, ambiguity preserved

research_basis.note: Implicit variant of LongMemEval knowledge updates; the benchmark covers explicit updates, implicit inference is our extrapolation.

turns: I work as a delivery partner at Zomato
First day at Swiggy was hectic, so many orders

recall_probes.ask: Where do I work these days?

notes: Old job must NOT be silently deleted; new job is an inference, keep both visible until user confirms.

category_name: Implicit update, ambiguity preserved

research_basis.note: Relationship change implying plan change; benchmark does not cover implied cancellations.

Riya and I broke up last night.

recall_probes.ask: What plans do I have for December?

notes: Goa plan must remain visible with uncertainty, not silently deleted. Emotional sensitivity on the breakup.

category_name: Durable fact embedded in a question

research_basis.source: How People Use ChatGPT, NBER w34255 / OpenAI summary (openai.com/index/how-people-are-using-chatgpt/); Miryn live test Oct 2026
research_basis.note: 49% of consumer ChatGPT messages are Asking (NBER). Miryn's own Oct 31 live test lost exactly this kind of pet detail.

turns: Given that my dog Biscuit is allergic to chicken, what food should I buy?

recall_probes.ask: What do I need to watch out for when feeding Biscuit?

notes: The allergy is a durable fact; the buying question is not.

category_name: Durable fact embedded in a request

research_basis.source: How People Use ChatGPT, NBER w34255 / OpenAI summary (openai.com/index/how-people-are-using-chatgpt/)
research_basis.note: 49% Asking / 40% Doing: most real messages are requests that carry personal context.

turns: Can you remind me to call nani tomorrow? my exam finally ends on May 12

notes: Store the durable date; the reminder phrasing is not itself a fact.

category_name: Preference reversal with polarity flip

research_basis.note: Knowledge-update variant: stance flip. LongMemEval covers value updates; polarity tracking is the failure mode we test.

turns: I hate coriander, please never add it to my food suggestions
Update: I actually like coriander now, had amazing Thai food

notes: Note: 'do not like coriander anymore' would AGREE with 'hates coriander'; only a polarity flip is a correction.

category_name: Preference reversal with polarity flip

research_basis.note: Second polarity case.

turns: Running is not for me at all, I hate it
Did my first 5k today and actually loved it

recall_probes.ask: How do I feel about running these days?

category_name: Relative date must resolve to absolute

research_basis.note: Temporal reasoning is a named LongMemEval ability; LoCoMo found LLMs lag humans most (73%) on temporal reasoning.

turns: My interview is next Tuesday at 11am
bit nervous about it

notes: Next Tuesday on 2026-10-08 = 2026-10-13. Storing only the phrase 'next Tuesday' goes stale; resolution should happen at write time.

category_name: Date without year, no fabrication

research_basis.note: Ambiguous dates must stay ambiguous.

turns: Mom's birthday is on 3rd March, want to plan something this year

notes: Do not invent a year; treat as recurring or ask.

category_name: Never-stated fact must not be invented

research_basis.note: Abstention is a named LongMemEval ability: knowing when the history does not contain the answer.

turns: What's my favorite movie?

notes: Correct behavior: say it was never shared. Any confident answer is a fabrication (compare the Miryn 'home' claim found in live testing).

category_name: Never-stated event must not be invented

research_basis.note: Same as AB-01.

turns: When is my dentist appointment?

notes: Correct behavior: ask for the details instead of inventing a date.

category_name: User corrects their own earlier value

research_basis.note: Self-correction variant of knowledge update.

turns: My flight to Mumbai is on the 21st

recall_probes.ask: What date is my Mumbai flight?

category_name: Correcting the assistant is not a user fact

research_basis.note: Users correcting model world-knowledge errors is common in real logs; it carries no user fact.

turns: Is Paris in Germany?
That's wrong, Paris is in France, you should know basic geography lol

notes: Nothing about the user here; a memory system must store nothing.

research_basis.note: WildChat spans 68 languages; code-mixing studies show multilingual users mix languages mid-sentence. Miryn's audience is Indian users.

category_name: Venting is not a permanent identity fact

research_basis.source: How People Use ChatGPT, NBER w34255 / OpenAI summary (openai.com/index/how-people-are-using-chatgpt/); OpenAI/MIT affective-use study, arXiv:2504.03888
research_basis.note: 11% of messages are Expressing; affective-use study: a small group of users drives most emotional cues, heavy use correlates with dependence.
